slides.texte_overlay:
weird habits that made me
a morning person

my alarm lives far away

i keep my alarm on the other side of the room. walking over to turn it off means i'm already standing before my brain can start arguing with me about it.

a breakfast worth waking for

i choose tomorrow's breakfast the night before. knowing something delicious is waiting makes leaving a warm bed so much easier on a cold, dark winter morning.

something new with coffee

i spend 5 minutes with my coffee learning something new, and it makes waking up feel exciting instead of heavy. curiosity is a far better reason to get up than any alarm.
slides.texte_sophia:
something new with coffee

i spend 5 minutes with my coffee on one lesson in the Sophia app, a myth or a planet. having something new to learn makes waking up feel exciting instead of heavy.

slides.texte_overlay:
the open window

i open the window the moment i get up, whatever the weather. the fresh air wakes me up faster than any coffee and makes the whole room feel fresh and new.

same bedtime, every night

i go to bed at the same time every night, weekends included. the secret to easy mornings was always the evening before, never the loud alarm clock itself.
